name: Pre-commit Execute

on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [precommit-run]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  precommit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: precommit-${{ github.event.client_payload.pr_number }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    steps:
      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          ignore_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          access_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          all_but_latest: true
          only_status: 'in_progress'

      - name: Checkout PR branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.client_payload.ref }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run pre-commit
        uses: pre-commit/action@v3.0.1
        with:
          extra_args: --all-files
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Commit pre-commit changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          message: "Apply pre-commit fixes"
          add: "."
          cwd: "."
          push: true
          default_author: github_actor

      - name: Comment on PR - success
        if: success()
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ✅ Pre-commit run completed successfully. Changes have been committed to the PR branch.
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.client_payload.pr_number }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Comment on PR - failure
        if: failure()
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ❌ Pre-commit run failed. Please check the logs and fix the issues.
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.client_payload.pr_number }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
